name: fast-compaction
description: Verbatim Jev-guided compaction for Claude Code sessions.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

preserveStartMessages.title: Start messages to preserve
preserveStartMessages.description: Number of oldest messages the token budget never demotes; active with target floor compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete requests compaction.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

targetFloorStartPercent.title: Target floor start (%)
targetFloorStartPercent.description: Compaction target as a percentage of the context window, starting here; steps down after each accepted Jev compaction and resets on any fallback to the built-in summary.

targetFloorMinPercent.title: Target floor minimum (%)
targetFloorMinPercent.description: Lowest percentage of the context window the compaction target may step down to.

targetFloorStepPercent.title: Target floor step (%)
targetFloorStepPercent.description: Percentage points the compaction target steps down after each accepted Jev compaction.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

model.title: Judge model
model.description: Model name sent with every request (e.g. jev-latest, or clef-flash on a local Ollama).

baseUrl.title: Judge endpoint (local model)
baseUrl.description: Full System One endpoint to post to. Set to e.g. http://desktop:11434/v1/systemone to use a local Ollama decision model; then no API key is needed. Leave empty for the TypeSafe cloud.

jevTimeoutMs.title: Jev timeout (ms)
jevTimeoutMs.description: How long compaction waits for Jev before falling back to the built-in summary; keep it under the engine's hook budget.

trainingLog.title: Log training data
trainingLog.description: Append one local JSONL record whenever a compaction asks Jev (redacted state, questions, Jev's answers, decisions) for future model training. Data never leaves this machine.

trainingDir.title: Training data directory
trainingDir.description: Where trainingLog writes its JSONL files. Defaults to ~/.fast-compaction/training.
